title: Popup position is wrong for rotated applets on a desktop and popup flashes if the mouse cursor hovers over it
line: Tooltips and popups of rotated desktop widgets, and the tooltips of their edit-mode toolbar, now open next to what they belong to instead of away from it.
explanation: PopupPlasmaWindow (used by applet popups and tooltips) built its anchor rect from the visual parent's mapped top-left corner plus its unrotated size, so for a rotated desktop widget a popup or tooltip landed on top of the widget, and a tooltip under the pointer hid and reappeared in a loop. The edit-mode toolbar rotates with the widget, and its buttons' tooltips are Qt Quick popups, which only map their top-left point through the rotated button and then lay out unrotated, so they opened away from their button. The libplasma change maps the whole item rect to the scene, giving the rotated bounding box; the plasma-desktop change places each toolbar tooltip above its button's rotated bounds. Unrotated items get the same positions as before.

commits.message:
plasmaquick: anchor popups to the visual parent's rotated bounds

The anchor rect was built from the visual parent's mapped top-left
corner and its unrotated size, so popups and tooltips of rotated desktop
widgets ended up on top of the widget. Map the whole rect instead.

BUG: 501691

containments/desktop: place toolbar tooltips by the rotated buttons

Edit-mode toolbar tooltips were placed from the button's rotated corner
but laid out as if unrotated, so on a rotated widget they opened away
from their button. Place them above the button's rotated bounds instead.

BUG: 501691

From 1079c5005e546edea83237e9c76616de0a9bcddc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:49:49 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasmaquick: anchor popups to the visual parent's rotated
 bounds

The anchor rect was built from the visual parent's mapped top-left
corner and its unrotated size, so popups and tooltips of rotated desktop
widgets ended up on top of the widget. Map the whole rect instead.

BUG: 501691
---
 src/plasmaquick/popupplasmawindow.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/plasmaquick/popupplasmawindow.cpp b/src/plasmaquick/popupplasmawindow.cpp
index 3230442c9..7ea14f522 100644
--- a/src/plasmaquick/popupplasmawindow.cpp
+++ b/src/plasmaquick/popupplasmawindow.cpp
@@ -142,7 +142,7 @@ void PopupPlasmaWindowPrivate::updatePosition()
     }
     q->setTransientParent(m_visualParent->window());
     TransientPlacementHint placementHint;
-    QRectF parentAnchorRect = QRectF(m_visualParent->mapToScene(QPointF(0, 0)), m_visualParent->size());
+    QRectF parentAnchorRect = m_visualParent->mapRectToScene(QRectF(QPointF(0, 0), m_visualParent->size()));
 
     if (!m_floating) {
         QRect windowVisibleRect = m_visualParent->window()->mask().boundingRect();
--

From d022f29dc4c820a58f357d9ee2ded57ba1db5661 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:18:36 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/desktop: place toolbar tooltips by the rotated
 buttons

Edit-mode toolbar tooltips were placed from the button's rotated corner
but laid out as if unrotated, so on a rotated widget they opened away
from their button. Place them above the button's rotated bounds instead.

BUG: 501691
---
 containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ActionButton.qml | 8 ++++++++
 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ActionButton.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ActionButton.qml
index 2ea968de1c..a3a2b319f1 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ActionButton.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ActionButton.qml
@@ -37,6 +37,14 @@ PC3.ToolButton {
     PC3.ToolTip {
         id: toolTip
         text: button.qAction ? button.qAction.text : ""
+        // The toolbar rotates with the widget but the tooltip doesn't, so place it above the button's rotated bounds
+        readonly property point rotatedPosition: {
+            visible;
+            const bounds = button.mapToItem(null, 0, 0, button.width, button.height);
+            return button.mapFromItem(null, bounds.x + (bounds.width - implicitWidth) / 2, bounds.y - implicitHeight - 3);
+        }
+        x: Math.round(rotatedPosition.x)
+        y: Math.round(rotatedPosition.y)
         delay: 0
         visible: button.hovered && text.length > 0
         Kirigami.Theme.colorSet: Kirigami.Theme.Window
-- 
2.53.0

Fixed: the tooltip opens below the rotated clock

review.text: Textbook one-line root-cause fix in libplasma. Replacing the top-left-plus-unrotated-size rect with QQuickItem::mapRectToScene() gives the rotated bounding box for rotated desktop widgets while remaining identical for unrotated items. Screenshots and autotests cleanly confirm that both tooltips and applet popups now open outside the rotated widget rather than on top of it.

reviews.text: Textbook one-line root-cause fix in libplasma. Replacing the top-left-plus-unrotated-size rect with QQuickItem::mapRectToScene() gives the rotated bounding box for rotated desktop widgets while remaining identical for unrotated items. Screenshots and autotests cleanly confirm that both tooltips and applet popups now open outside the rotated widget rather than on top of it.

My earlier request is resolved. A plasma-desktop commit with BUG: 501691 now places the edit-mode toolbar tooltips from each button's rotated scene bounds, mapped back into the button so Qt's popup positioner puts the top-left where it is wanted, which gives exactly the old position at 0°. before/after-3 and -4 show the Remove and rotate tooltips moving from off to the side to right above their buttons at 45° and 135°. The unchanged libplasma one-liner (mapRectToScene) still fixes applet tooltips and popups with no change for unrotated items, so the report is covered as described. Nit: the bare `visible;` dependency used to re-evaluate the position is a slightly unusual idiom but is commented and harmless.

history.text: The libplasma change is the right root cause for applet tooltips and popups: PopupPlasmaWindow combined the mapped top-left corner with the unrotated size, and mapRectToScene gives the rotated item's bounding box while leaving unrotated items (panels, every normal applet) unchanged. The screenshots show the clock tooltip and calendar moving from on top of the rotated clock to below it, which also removes the cause of the hover flicker. But the reporter's description (and TraceyC's confirmation in c1) explicitly includes the edit-mode toolbar tooltips (rotate, configure, show/hide background, remove) being offset on a rotated widget, and the notes admit those still are, because they are PC3.ToolTips in plasma-desktop's ActionButton/ConfigOverlay, so this fix only covers part of the bug.
changes: Also fix the edit-mode toolbar tooltips on rotated desktop widgets in plasma-desktop (containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ActionButton.qml / ConfigOverlay.qml, e.g. position the PC3.ToolTip from the button's rotation-aware mapped rect or parent it outside the rotated item), with before/after screenshots of a rotated widget's toolbar tooltips, and give that commit BUG: 501691 alongside the libplasma one

Alternatively, if the toolbar part is split into its own report, change this commit to CCBUG: 501691 and reference the new bug, since BUG: here would close the report with the toolbar part still broken

history.summary: Added a plasma-desktop commit (BUG: 501691) that places the edit-mode toolbar tooltips above each button's rotated bounds, next to the unchanged libplasma commit. New before/after shots show the Configure, Remove and rotate tooltips on a widget rotated 45° and 135°.

answers.request: Also fix the edit-mode toolbar tooltips on rotated desktop widgets in plasma-desktop (containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ActionButton.qml / ConfigOverlay.qml, e.g. position the PC3.ToolTip from the button's rotation-aware mapped rect or parent it outside the rotated item), with before/after screenshots of a rotated widget's toolbar tooltips, and give that commit BUG: 501691 alongside the libplasma one
answers.answer: Done in ActionButton.qml. Qt Quick's popup positioner maps only the tooltip's top-left point through the rotated button and then lays it out unrotated. The tooltip's x/y now come from the button's rotated scene bounds (centered, 3 px above, the same as PC3.ToolTip's defaults), mapped back into the button. They are re-evaluated whenever the tooltip is shown or resized. For unrotated buttons this gives exactly the old position. Verified on kdetest9 at 45° and 135° (before-3/after-3, before-4/after-4) and at 0° (no change). The commit has BUG: 501691.

answers.request: Alternatively, if the toolbar part is split into its own report, change this commit to CCBUG: 501691 and reference the new bug, since BUG: here would close the report with the toolbar part still broken
answers.answer: Not needed: the toolbar part is fixed in this revision, so both commits keep BUG: 501691.
